## Implementation Notes
Add a subsection to .claude/docs/KNOWN-ISSUES.md covering:
1. Echo-suppression invariant is content-hash equality across sides on the CURRENT pass — NOT cross-pass history.
2. Operators must NOT add persistent provenance storage to 'fix' an apparent re-echo; first investigate whether both sides actually carry hash-equal values now.
3. Reference story 26de-eb67-29d2-48ae and the ProvenanceLedger module.
4. Note the 'side' parameter naming aligned with dd-3 wording.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
